fundamentals.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the semiconductor industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. The fund is non-diversified.

news.paragraph: The VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) is facing scrutiny as investors watch hyperscaler capital expenditure guidance during upcoming July earnings calls. Recent analysis compares SMH against SOXX and suggests buying dips in AI and chip ETFs, though one analyst has expressed a bearish outlook on chip stocks. The ETF's performance will likely be tied to the capital spending intentions of major cloud providers and the overall health of the semiconductor industry.
